28 original, subject-specific decision-check questions with offline persistence and source references.
Automated test/build/browser verification passed for the decision clinic release.
Twelve previously short advanced foundation lessons now have substantive applied section, worked example and supporting source.
Successful unit, offline-build and desktop/mobile Chromium verification for the advanced enrichment release.
Every one of 134 lessons now has a two-step evidence-check and transfer-challenge guide specific to subject and level, without mutating frozen source content.
23 previously short worked examples and 20 brief answer rationales expanded with concrete subject-specific reasoning.
201 unit tests passed; production build and full real Chromium desktop/mobile/offline suite passed. Coverage: 134/134 worked examples, answer rationales, source links and guided reflection prompts.
Deepened 18 high-stakes Philippine legal, finance, digital-security and anti-coercion foundation lessons with specific applied cases.

Expanded 18 communication, reasoning, career, science, relationships and negotiation foundation lessons.
Addressed 11 remaining section-depth and applied-task gaps in the sourced applied and advanced learning library.

209 passing unit tests, verified static/offline build and desktop/mobile Chromium integration. Automated audit: 134/134 sections, examples, assignments, rationales, guided practice, links; 0 structural flags.
Practice exams can now target Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced or all lessons, with mature material excluded and existing exam backups preserved.
Weekly official-course source checker now validates every public HTTPS redirect before following it and rejects unsafe, looping or excessive redirect chains.
Official-source register expanded to six limited date-stamped NPC/BSP/DTI claim checks; DTI casework links the official post-mediation adjudication procedure.
Latest branch build, Node tests and Chromium desktop/mobile/offline smoke tests passed after source traceability changes.
Original advanced decision added to every subject; subject clinics now contain 42 scenario questions.
Third-case tests corrected and keyboard assessment response focus moved to the explanation, verified in browser.
Full source-accurate reviewer packet generator added: 134 lessons and 42 decisions with SHA-256 content hashes and supporting references.
217 Node tests passed, offline build and real desktop/mobile browser checks succeeded. Editorial reviewer packet archived in GitHub Actions.

blockers: Qualified independent reviewers still need to inspect and sign off all 134 lessons, especially the Philippine legal/financial and safety-related content; the editorial packet is prepared, not approved.
Assessments, distractors and pedagogy require independent validity and suitability review. A passing automated test suite or an unverified reviewer field cannot establish substantive accuracy.
The 42 referenced URLs, all material claims, and language/cultural guidance still require dated claim-level or specialist review. Six official-source spot checks remain only partial evidence.
